_todo: OQ-ART-WORLD (M2W1 item 4): the ground's detail look. Every number and colour is an art trial on alesia_1km, not a design value.
_note: Read by WorldSurface.ground_material when the graphics preset has art_ground_detail_enabled (off: the S2 ground exactly). Keys in "uniforms" are the uniform names of scripts/visual/shaders/ground.gdshader (colours are sRGB); rock_layer_name is a data/art_materials.json layer name; rock_tile_m becomes rock_tiles_per_m. Never put these in art_materials.json "ground" (its keys are hashed into the ground paint inputs). Scales: detail_large_m / detail_mid_m / detail_near_m are the noise tiles (the 360 m tile's macro channel makes ~60 m patches, the 90 m tile's ~15 m patches and ~2-3 m grain). Slopes: 1 - normal.y (0.06 ~ 20 deg, 0.12 ~ 28 deg; the citadel hill's steepest is 29 deg).
_astraB_note: M2W1 astraB (F7, F2, F9; OQ-ART-WORLD placeholders): uniforms trodden_* / shelter_* / contact_dark / open_* (the place map's masks), near_break (breaks the earth tile's pebble repeat with the near noise), hill_* (the citadel hill's bands; heights in metres above the plain), puddle_roughness / puddle_specular / wet_rough_vary (storm wetness).
_place_map_note: M2W1 astraB: scripts/visual/place_map.gd. px = the texture's side over the ground square. apron_by_type (structure type: [inner m, outer m, value]) = trodden R round its footprints that reach the ground; shelter_by_type ([lee offset m, inner m, outer m, value]) = G on the lee side (lee_dir: the dusk sun's shadow direction on the ground, x/z) plus a foot band all round; wall_foot_contact = B along those feet out to wall_foot_m; cover_apron / chest_apron [inner, outer, value]; door_apron [inner, outer, value, reach along the lane m]; track [inner, outer, value, longest m] from each camp's centre to its nearest gate; neighbour_track [inner, outer, value, longest m] from each camp building to its nearest neighbour; contact [inner share of the radius, outer extra m, value] under clutter clusters and patches.
